name: standmeet-caldav-mcp
description: A CalDAV block as a Koishi plugin: it injects Koishi's `http` service (the HTTP hand) for the WebDAV requests and parses iCalendar with ical.js (a real library, unmodified). CalDAV is an app on HTTP, so it is a block — pluggable into Koishi like every other block — not a base protocol, and it carries no Go. Wrapped as a stdio-MCP block the same way infra/plugins/koishi wraps koishi-plugin-base64.
